subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice channel decision & template questions
messages:
From: Julia Santos <billing@acme-corp.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick q: portal vs. email for invoice submission + sample template?

Hi Karthik / Laura,

We're getting ready to start billing Redwood for the first month of usage and want to make sure our invoice process lines up with your AP. Two quick questions:

1) Is the vendor portal mandatory, or can we email invoices to a billing mailbox for now? Our finance team prefers SFTP/portal but can do email while portal access is being provisioned.

2) Do you have a sample invoice template or CSV we should follow (line items, tax fields, PO stamping)?

Attaching our internal invoice template for reference. Happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Julia Santos
Vendor Ops Lead
Acme Cloud Services
attachments: acme_invoice_template.docx (attachment stub)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Julia Santos <billing@acme-corp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-18T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick q: portal vs. email for invoice submission + sample template?

Hi Julia — thanks for the note and the template. Short version: we strongly prefer portal for new vendors (automation, PO matching, idempotency) but we support an email fallback while portal access is being set up. A few specifics to make the transition smooth: 

- Portal advantages: automatic PO-match, faster ACKs, structured fields (line-level GL mapping), and reduced manual processing time. If you can provision the portal, we can onboard you in ~3 business days.
- Email fallback: allowed for first 2 billing cycles. Requires a subject token in the email: "INV-ACME-{vendor_id}-{invoice_date}" and the invoice attached as PDF or a CSV in the exact column order we provide. Bcc is allowed but not recommended.

I've attached a sample CSV (sample_invoice_csv.csv) with the exact column order we ingest and an example PO-stamp image for how our AP team prefers the PO number to appear on the PDF. Key fields we require: invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), po_number, line_description, qty, unit_price, currency, tax_amount, total_amount, vendor_tax_id.

Two questions for you before we proceed:
1) Do you have invoices that contain multiple PO numbers on a single PDF? (We can handle multi-PO but prefer one PO per invoice for automation.)
2) Do you need a parity mapping doc for any internal GL fields? Priyom can create a quick mapping table.

Next steps: if you're ready to go portal route, send over the contact for your portal admin and we'll invite them. If you need email fallback, follow the subject convention above and use the attached CSV layout.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: sample_invoice_csv.csv, po-stamp-example.png

Subject: Re: Quick q: portal vs. email for invoice submission + sample template?

Hi Julia — appreciate the quick replies and the sample files. Summary and recommended path forward: 

1) Consolidated invoices (multiple POs on one PDF) — Not a hard blocker, but: 
   - Portal ingestion supports a single invoice file that lists multiple PO lines; our parser will create line-level allocations to each PO if each line includes the PO number. 
   - For the email fallback, please include a companion CSV with the row for each invoice line (one row per PO/line) alongside the PDF and reference the PDF filename in column "pdf_filename". This preserves automation and reduces reconciliation time.

2) Vendor legacy tax ID — include that in the column "vendor_tax_id" (we also accept "tax_id" as an alias). If you have multiple tax jurisdictions, include the jurisdiction code in a separate column "tax_jurisdiction".

3) Portal vs Email recommendation: 
   - Best: Portal (fastest, lowest error rate). We'll prioritize creating your portal account.
   - Acceptable short-term: Email fallback with subject token: INV-ACME-4872-20250630 and the CSV included. Use PDF for the invoice and CSV for structured lines.

I've attached the vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf that our onboarding team needs filled (contact, remit address, bank info, preferred invoice channel) and a quick 20-minute slot we can take tomorrow at 11:00 AM PT to walk through portal setup or the CSV columns. Priyom will own the mapping and will send a compact GL parity sheet after the call.

Next steps: please confirm preferred channel and who should be the portal admin (email address). If portal, we will send the invite and provisional instructions for SSO or password access.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
